title: EconomyRPG
description: Jobs, shop, auction house, and wealth tax , pvp system – turn Minecraft into an RPG economy
body:
**_🧠 What does this mod do?_**
A full economy RPG system with jobs, shops, auctions, PvP rewards, and wealth-based pricing.

_**💰 Economy System**_
- Start with $100 balance
- Real-time balance tracking (sidebar display)

_**⚒️ Jobs System**_
Earn money while playing normally:

⛏ Miner — ores 

🪵 Lumberjack — logs

🌾 Farmer — crops

🏹 Hunter — mobs + PvP rewards

🧱 Builder — block placement

**_btw its full editable_**

**_🏪 Shop System (/shop)_**
- Massive categorized shop (Weapons, Tools, Armor, Food, Blocks, etc.)
- Buy 1 item or 64 items instantly
- Search system: /shop search diamond
- Wealth Tax System — prices increase based on player balance to prevent inflation and keep the economy balanced

**_🏷️ Auction House (/ah)_**
- Player-to-player trading system
- Instant buying and selling
- Search auctions: /ah search sword

**_⚔️ PvP Rewards_**
- Kill a player → earn $30 + 10% of their balance
- Victim loses part of the reward
- Hunters get ×1.5 bonus on PvP kills

**_🧑‍💼 Main GUI System (/menu)_**
- View balance and job
- Sell items instantly
- Change jobs
- View richest players
- Easy access to all economy features

_**⚙️ Fully Configurable**_
- Auto-generated config/economyrpg.toml
- All payouts, prices, and systems can be edited without coding

**_🎮 How to start_**
/menu → open main GUI

/jobmenu or /setjob Miner → choose a job

Play normally to earn money

/shop → buy items (prices depend on wealth)

/ah sell <price> → list items for sale

**_🧾 Commands_**
Most features are available through the GUI or in-game help menu.

Core commands:

/menu → Open main GUI

/balance → Check your money

/shop → Open shop

/ah → Auction house

/jobmenu or /setjob → Choose a job

**_please use /balance not /bal_**

⚠️ **Requirements
NeoForge only
Fabric and Forge are not supported**
